Deeper.description:
DA5 1b: the page behind this browser check is being opened in the sandbox. Ask again after
`retry_after_s` seconds: the page's own verdict (if graver) is then given back.
Deeper.title: Deeper

FileCheck.description: What the agent knows about a file it did not send (too big, or not an openable type).
FileCheck.title: FileCheck

FileSummary.description: What was found in one attachment, in fixed words and numbers (never file content).
FileSummary.title: FileSummary

HashMatch.description: A hash that is on a known-bad list: which kind, which list, and what it matched.
HashMatch.title: HashMatch

OverrideRequest.description: The user chose to continue to a page the extension warned about (decision D5).
OverrideRequest.title: OverrideRequest

PageSummary.description: What the sandboxed browser saw (D1). Shown to the caller once; not stored.
PageSummary.title: PageSummary

ResponseAction.description: Never includes deletion: responses are reversible (CLAUDE.md rule 7).
ResponseAction.title: ResponseAction

SessionBody.description: Console sign-in: a one-time code, or nothing when the API token is in the header.
SessionBody.title: SessionBody

UrlAnatomy.description:
How the analysed URL splits into parts, for the console's "anatomy" view. Echoes the caller's
own input back to them (the password, if any, is never included); nothing here is logged or
stored.
UrlAnatomy.title: UrlAnatomy

UrlFlag.description: Facts about how the input differed from its normalised form. Not verdicts.
UrlFlag.title: UrlFlag

get.description:
Open to anyone, but it can prove who it is: given a nonce it also returns an HMAC of it
keyed with the API token. The agent checks that before it sends the token, URLs or files to
whatever is listening on the port (any local program can bind a port the real core left).

post.description: What the agent did. Only the agent reports this; the console cannot claim a result.

schema.title: Response Allow List V1 Allowlist Get
Response Allow Remove V1 Allowlist  Sha256  Delete

post.description: A one-time code for `Lynceus.Agent --open-console`: one console session, for 60 s.

schema.title: Response Console Code V1 Console Code Post
Response Console Sign Out V1 Console Session Delete

post.description: Trade a one-time code, or the API token typed at the sign-in screen, for a session.

schema.title: Response Console Session V1 Console Session Post

post.description: Your answer about a verdict: a false alarm, a missed phishing, or right (H1 B3).

schema.title: Response Feedback V1 Events  Verdict Id  Feedback Post

get.description: Per rule, how often you called its verdicts false alarms: the noisy rules here.

schema.title: Response Feedback Rules V1 Feedback Rules Get

get.description: Counts and states only: never an address, a subject or a token.

schema.title: Response Mailbox Status V1 Mailbox Status Get

post.description:
D1: the URL verdict, then the page opened in the sandboxed browser container, then one
verdict over both. Off unless LYNCEUS_DETONATION is set: it visits the page from this
computer's internet connection, so every visit is audited (who asked, how it went; no
URL).
